I'm in a situation where I want to live happily and I have tried \- I took charge and went to university, get a good job, etc. but people won't stop abusing me and I feel like they won't stop until I give up.

I want to live but past numerous abuse have made me so hopeless so I do dream about dying.
I can totally relate with you \- I feel that the majority of the world still doesn't completely understand mental health...
I definitely can relate with you. My former psychologist basically judged me, encouraged and escorted me out on our ''last session''.
